scope: Full 170-SM RTX 5090; B1/H16/D256, S1024/S4096, dense/causal, BF16/FP16, contiguous training. Actual public forward/backward/joint comparisons; synthetic aligned inputs, not complete-model performance.

protocol.boundary: CUDA events around complete warmed eager calls or one captured complete call; backward reuses retained forward, joint includes fresh forward and all gradients
protocol.baseline_isolation: Prior Python family and public function bound once to its actual prior native extension; live widened candidate metadata predicate cannot contaminate the prior control.

acceptance: Independent per-head FP64 norm limits: BF16 1%, FP16 0.5%, separately for O/dQ/dK/dV; rounded P/dS and actual rounded O delta contract unchanged; literal unscaled maximum/logarithmic statistics checked.

actual_api_checks.scope: Actual public APIs; FP64 diagnostics outside sanitizers; unchanged rounded contract. Prior selector uses its actual retained native library, not the new widened predicate.

memcheck.scope: Actual public selected calls; exact CPU copies and unchanged equations. Compiler-returned original images retained without a CUPTI injection under sanitizer.
